submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Sb 0.611) had the highest measured EQE, 0.847%. Its neighbours were lower: index 13 (Sb 0.643) gave 0.449%, index 10 (Sb 0.538) gave 0.549%, index 14 (Sb 0.758) gave 0.091% and index 0 (Sb 0.237) gave 0.005%. So the peak falls near Sb 0.58–0.61, just below the ZnSb2O6 stoichiometry. XRD is dominated by the Pt substrate lines. Only one weak film peak shows up, at Q≈2.45, and it grows as Sb increases. That fits a trirutile ZnSb2O6 phase fraction that goes up toward index 13, but the peak alone doesn't tell phases apart. Index 11 (Sb 0.577) was never measured and may be close to the maximum.
